chapter: By Thy Pale Beams I Solitary Rove
act_title: By Thy Pale Beams I Solitary Rove

quests.title: By Thy Pale Beams I Solitary Rove

dialogue.t: Look, guys! I flipped through my father's sailing log again.
There's an appendix in there that mentions a special fish bait formula they had developed.
When they encountered the "Lunar Leviathan," they used a special bait that mixed Seagrass and Magical Crystal Ore.
If we can also make this, we may be able to attract the "Lunar Leviathan."
I have a lot of Seagrass, but the Magical Crystal Ore...
Eh? Really? Were they mined at Araumi?
My father's log mentioned that the Magical Crystal Ore must be mined from the ruins at Araumi.
Although I'm not sure what the difference is, compared to ordinary Magical Crystal Ore, but since we have decided to do so, we should be more rigorous and follow the sailing log closely.
Speaking of which, there are a lot of dangerous monsters over at Araumi. Let's go to the Adventurers' Guild and put up a commission.
Ah... Right, I forgot you are a powerful adventurer!
I'm so lucky to have your help, I'm counting on you!
I'll go back and get some bait-making tools, let's meet up later at the beach on the west of Araumi.
You found them so quickly? You're a powerful adventurer indeed!
Well, watch me next, I just have to do this...this...and this...
This should be it, that's all.
The next step is to scatter the bait and wait for the "Lunar Leviathan" to appear, right?
Yes, I purposely chose this place, from where we reached the shore back then.
The "Lunar Leviathan" that guided us back to the ship also disappeared here.
So, is everyone ready? Don't forget to make a wish when you see the "Lunar Leviathan."
Don't say such discouraging things, it will work. The "Lunar Leviathan" will definitely come.
Yeah! It will work! Big fish, big fish, you must be good and bite the bait! I'm counting on you!
Look! Look at this! It's glowing under the water! Something's coming!
Really? Is the "Lunar Leviathan" really here?
Help, it's a Ruin Guard!
Why is it this guy!
How...how did this happen, even my father's bait formula didn't work?
Don't be sad, it's that Ruin Guard's fault! It must have scared the "Lunar Leviathan" away! Let's try again!
Let's forget it for now, I'm a little tired. Maybe Nantuck is right?
*sigh* I want to go and take a stroll outside. I have to think about what happens after this.
Here's your payment. Whatever the case, thank you very much for your help.
Looks like Ms. Kujirai wants to be left alone now, let's come back to see her later.

quests.description: Kujirai Momiji seems to have found some useful resources. Rendezvous with her, pronto…
